name: Android Agent Arena (A3)
description: Android Agent Arena (A3) is a benchmark and procedural evaluation system for mobile GUI agents, featuring 100 tasks from 20 dynamic online apps and an essential-state based evaluation method using MLLMs as reward models.
reputation: A3 is a recent research benchmark from the mobile-agent literature and is not yet a widely established community standard, but it is relevant to ongoing work on Android GUI agents.
notes: Focuses on dynamic, real-world online mobile apps with a novel essential-state based procedural evaluation.
